sections.heading: In-Game Description
sections.text:
A tattered note written by Anayama. Seems to be from some years ago.
"Lucrative info #36.
When we broke into Hirata Estate, we found a barrel that spewed flame. The boys lit a roaring bonfire with it and made merry with the drink. Must have been a shinobi's tool."

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Contains a clue about the whereabouts of Flame Barrel, that unlocks the Flame Vent Prosthetic Tool when given to the Sculptor at the Dilapidated Temple.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Killing Anayama in the Hirata Estate, prior to its purchase, will make this item unobtainable for the rest of the playthrough.
